description: The image presents two bar charts illustrating the relationship between Fleiss Kappa and two different measures of ambiguity, namely Ambiguity Std and Max Ambiguity. The horizontal axis in both charts represents the categories of ambiguity, while the vertical axis represents Fleiss Kappa values. In the left chart, the categories are labeled with Ambiguity Std values (0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94), and the corresponding Fleiss Kappa values are 0.88, 0.46, 0.03, and 0.24, respectively. The bars are colored in varying shades of blue, with the darkest shade representing the highest Fleiss Kappa value. The right chart displays categories labeled with Max Ambiguity values (1, 2, and 3), with corresponding Fleiss Kappa values of 0.89, 0.46, and 0.23. The bars in both charts are not grouped or stacked, and their heights decrease as the ambiguity measures increase. The Fleiss Kappa values on the vertical axis range from 0.0 to 0.8 in both charts, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The bars are not sorted in a specific order other than being arranged according to their corresponding category labels on the horizontal axis, and no bars are visually emphasized.
